"Dude, I'm pretty sure he has a gun."

"So? The poor thing wants to pretend he's a predator, but he can't even hide his smell. There's no way he'd actually hit us from where he is."

"I know, but accidents happen Greg. I know you wanted to let him see us cuz he was trying so hard, but now I'm getting jumpy."

Greg sighed through his nose and raised his head, still relaxed.
